title: Successor
summary: Successor moves from one natural number to the next.

assumptions.text: The declared natural-number arithmetic context is fixed.

content.plain: Successor moves from one natural number to the next.
content.exact: A Peano-style successor S:N→N is injective and never maps any n to 0.
content.example: S(0) is written 1; S(S(0)) is written 2.
content.caveat: The properties of successor come from the chosen arithmetic axioms.
